# CTRL+R

> CTRL+R is one unified platform to operate and manage your entire physical AI fleet: robots, drones, cameras, and sensors, from any manufacturer. One platform. Any device. Total control. Built in Dubai, serving the UAE and GCC.

CTRL+R helps businesses build, operate, and scale their autonomous workforce. A lightweight agent installed on each robot connects it to CTRL+R, and the team then works from one web-based command center, Command HQ.

Key facts:

- Works with robots from any manufacturer. Robots that run ROS 1 or ROS 2 are supported, and drones, IP cameras, and sensors connect alongside them.
- Teleoperation from a web browser using a joystick, keyboard bindings, gamepad or custom controllers, or by sending a robot to a saved location in one click.
- Fleet management across sites, teams, and devices, with a live map of every connected device.
- Every session is recorded end to end and time-stamped; warnings, faults, and actions are logged as searchable events.
- Security: end-to-end encrypted sessions, robots connect outbound only (no open inbound ports), role-based access, and a full audit trail.
- Built for anyone, not just engineers: first-time operators can use it, and robotics teams can customize it (controls, key bindings, saved locations, ROS commands).
- Deployment in the cloud (hosted by CTRL+R) or on-premises.
- For robot makers (OEMs) and distributors: CTRL+R can be white-labeled, so every robot sold comes with fleet operations on day one, and distributors can offer one platform across mixed fleets.
- Small fleets can try CTRL+R free; larger operations can start with a free pilot.

Contact: info@ctrlr.cloud
